prompt: please write a regex that has a capture group for a phone number and email in the text
response: To capture a phone number and an email in a text, you can use the following regex: `(\d{3}-\d{3}-\d{4})\s+(\S+@\S+)`. This pattern will match a phone number in the format 123-456-7890 and an email address right after it, with a space in between.
